title: Define and manage organizational performance strategy
goal: The venture has one model of how it is measured: each measure defined once, computed from named records, tied to the goal it serves, and kept the same between readings so two readings can be compared.

steps.do: Write, as a process record, each measure the venture reads: its one definition, the records it is computed from, the window it covers, who reads it and the goal it serves, and drop any measure nobody acts on.

Check each definition against how the measure was last computed, and when a definition has to change, record the change with its date and keep the old series separate so a break is never read as a trend.
Raise to the strategy lead any measure the venture reads that serves no live goal, and record the measurement model as evidence on the handoff.

done_criteria.check: Does every measure have one definition naming the records it is computed from and the goal it serves, with any changed definition dated and its old series kept separate?
